_doc: TANG 2 — nganh giay chay: "phien ban" cua giay la gi khi so anh khach voi anh catalog (01/10/2026).
huongDan: Giay: DONG = mot mau giay qua nhieu doi; cac doi cua mot dong giu dang de, do day, dang than va kieu got gan nhau. Mot ten chung dat truoc nhieu dong (ten ho) KHONG lam chung thanh cung dong: hai dong cung ho thuong khac han do day de, dang mui, cau truc than — nhin hinh, khong nhin chu chung.

Giay: phien ban = DOI (Pegasus 40 / 41 / 42, Boston 12 / 13). Cac doi lien ke trong rat giong nhau — phan biet bang de giua (do day, duong cat, chu in), got, luoi ga, mieng lot co, duong may va lop phu than. Ban nam / nu cung doi tinh la CUNG phien ban.
Quan ao / phu kien: phien ban = cung kieu (dang ao, co, khoa, vi tri soc / logo); khac mau van la cung phien ban.
